title: Act 1 - Segment 8: Viridian Gym & Route 23 (Earth Badge)
synopsis: Return to Viridian City to challenge the 8th Gym Leader, revealed as Team Rocket Boss Giovanni commanding a ferocious Ground-type team in a 5v5 battle under the Level 54 cap to earn the Earth Badge. Defeat your Rival at Route 22 and clear the Route 23 badge checkpoints to reach Victory Road.
